clauses.quote: Budgeted funds shall be expended in a fair and efficient manner in accordance with state laws and common accounting practices
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit agent is the Board/Superintendent administering district funds.

clauses.quote: they shall be expended in a manner that promotes equity in the investment of financial resources for all students
The Superintendent shall, at least once per year, give the Board an overview of applicable developments in the field and his/her opinion as to their potential impact on the System.
